method_note: browser_batch available. Primary ms_per_op = in-batch bracket: javascript_tool Date.now() as first/last action of a browser_batch that runs the op N times, divided by N (bracket includes one extra ~2ms javascript_tool call). Bash time.time() brackets around a batch/single include two model turns of overhead (~5-8 s) and are reported only as 'with model overhead'. Every standalone tool result appends a ~208-char 'Tab Context' footer (one per batch); chars below exclude it. Test tab was hidden (document.visibilityState='hidden') in a background tab of the extension's own tab group the whole time.
